localChanges: Fork source_patch.py filters selected static Gaussian centers in source-world z-up before packed buffer assembly.
Authored region GLBs enter the existing mesh depth/composite pass; final depth also gates actor proxy visibility.
Injected actor GLBs use canonical engine state placement; no class-to-hatchback fallback.
Rigid retiming uses the shifted source clock for pitch/roll/height and Fourier appearance, leaving the background clock unchanged.
Full package SHA-256 checked in addition to volume.nurec member identity.
Determinism utility uses local native client path and excludes metadata keys from repeated cross-run comparison.
Empty static Gaussian-center selections fail with unsupported_nurec_region instead of accepting mesh-only replacement.
Forks retain a hashed source-background.json; loader and renderer reject capture/background identity changes.
Calibrated sensor extrinsic overrides are rejected rather than silently replacing the package rig.
CPU source adapter returns the canonical compiler MapBundle using map-intel derivation and the importer-pinned world-to-XODR fit.

Wire cut over to the native V5 contract (protocol 2 removed): render_bundle answers carry FrameIdentity {simTick, sceneRevision, rigRevision, generation}, per-request pass selection, per-frame CRC32 digest, an empty `device` map; scene-state streams retain every tick and honour tick_index; unsupported V5 ops (load, render, encode_jpeg, set_lighting, get_state, device streams) answer explicit capability errors instead of fake successes; hello declares transport host-shm and capabilities.
Rendering core extracted to backend.py (SplatBackend/SplatSession/TickRender) so the socket service and the in-process tensor adapter share one pixel implementation.

tensor.py adds the in-process NuRec-to-PyTorch sensor path: per-camera slot pools under one output-capacity account (default = declared pools), ready/handback CUDA event ordering with explicitly registered consumer streams, views retained past release() hold their slot (no reuse/free) until they are gone, retire on reset/re-register/scene change/close preserves views, explicit device/stream/channel/format capability errors, version-gated torch storage use-count check; no host staging; DLPack is same-process only.
jpeg output/encode requests are refused explicitly (no encoder); the never-published jpeg ring tag was removed from the writer.

job.py + __main__.py add the durable runner workload simforge.render-bundle-nurec/v1 (params/out-dir/resume, JSONL progress/checkpoint/done/canceled, exit 0/1/2/130) writing frames/<sensorId>/<pass>/tick-<06d>.<png|npy>, bundles.jsonl (V5 identity + ring-layout CRC32 digests) and results.json; declared host-files transport. `capabilities --no-probe` reports prerequisites without touching CUDA. Wire constants and pass validation live in protocol.py.
preservedBehavior: protocol 5 msgpack Unix socket (same request shapes as V4)
3DGUT tile sorting and shutter iteration settings
